source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "platform work" OR "platform workers" OR "platform labour" OR "platform labor"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"platform work" OR "platform workers" OR "platform labour" OR "platform labor",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("platform labor" OR "platform labour" OR "platform work" OR "platform workers")
